scripts.label: start-upload
scripts.output: mkdir -p '/srv/beam/work space/.beam' && printf '%s\n' ''\''omp'\'' '\''--resume'\'' '\''session '\''\'\'''\''x'\''\'\'''\'''\''; code=$?; echo; echo "[beam] agent exited ($code) - shell below"' > '/srv/beam/work space/.beam/agent-start.sh'

scripts.label: start-ensure-server
scripts.output:
dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/herdr-$(id -u)"; mkdir -p -m 700 "$dir" && [ -O "$dir" ] || { echo "beam: herdr socket dir $dir is not owned by uid $(id -u); remove it and retry" >&2; exit 1; }
if ! HERDR_SESSION='beam-parity' HERDR_SOCKET_PATH="$dir/beam-parity.sock" herdr pane list >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nohup env HERDR_SESSION='beam-parity' HERDR_SOCKET_PATH="$dir/beam-parity.sock" herdr server >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  tries=0
  until HERDR_SESSION='beam-parity' HERDR_SOCKET_PATH="$dir/beam-parity.sock" herdr pane list >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    tries=$((tries + 1))
    if [ "$tries" -ge 50 ]; then
      echo "beam: herdr server for session beam-parity did not answer after 50 probes (10s)" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 0.2
  done
fi

scripts.label: environment-consume
scripts.output:
attempts=0
while [ -e '/srv/beam/work space/.beam/runtime-environment/environment' ] || [ -L '/srv/beam/work space/.beam/runtime-environment/environment' ]; do
  attempts=$((attempts + 1))
  if [ "$attempts" -ge 50 ]; then
    echo "beam: coding client did not consume its runtime environment" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 0.1
done
